specialRulesBody.name: Festering Stooges
specialRulesBody.text: If Ku'gath Plaguefather is included in your army, you may upgrade one unit of Plaguebearers to the Festering Stooges for a cost of +1 point per model. This unit has the Regeneration (6+) special rule.

units.name: ROTIGUS
units.subtitle: The Generous One
units.magic: Rotigus is a Level 3 Wizard who use spells from the Lore of Nurgle.

magicItems.name: Gnarlrod of Nurgle
magicItems.text: Arcane Item. Staff. Bound Spell (Level 3, cast on 9+). The Gnarlrod of Nurgle contains a direct damage spell with a range of 24". When cast, roll a D6; this is the number of enemy units affected by the spell, chosen by Rotigus. Each affected unit suffers D6 Strength 3 Hits which Ignores Armour Saves.

specialRulesBody.name: Blubber and Bile
specialRulesBody.text: Each time Rotigus successfully makes a Regeneration save in close combat, he inflicts a Strength 4 Hit on the model which caused the Wound.

specialRulesBody.name: Streams of Brackish Filth
specialRulesBody.text: At the start of each of your Shooting phases, all enemy units within 6" of Rotigus suffer D3 Strength 4 Hits.

units.name: EPIDEMUS
units.subtitle: Nurgle's Tallyman
units.specialRulesBody:
• The Tally of Pestilence: Whilst Epidemius is alive, keep a count of all unsaved Wounds caused by any unit he is with in close combat (unless he has refused a challenge that turn). At the start of each of your turns, consult the table below to determine the effect of the Tally of Pestilence. Note that these effects are cumulative. If Epidemius is killed or leaves the unit, these effects are immediately lost.
Wounds | Effect
0-6 | No effect.
7+ | All models in the unit gain +1 Strength.
14+ | All models in the unit gain +1 Toughness.
21+ | All models in the unit gain the Killing Blow special rule.
28+ | All models in the unit re-roll failed Magical Ward saves.

specialRulesBody.name: Beast Handler
specialRulesBody.text: Friendly Beasts of Nurgle within 12" of Horticulous Slimux re-roll failed charge rolls and To Hit rolls of 1.

specialRulesBody.name: In Death There is Life
specialRulesBody.text: All friendly units within 6" of Horticulous Slimux gain the Regeneration (6+) special rule.

specialRulesBody.name: Cultivating the Garden of Nurgle
specialRulesBody.text: Once during the battle, at the start of your turns, you can set up a Venom Thicket (see the Warhammer Rulebook) within 3" of Horticulous Slimux and more than 1" away from any other model or terrain feature.

units.name: N'KARI
units.subtitle: The Arch-tempter
units.magic: N'Kari is a level 4 Wizard who use spells from the Lore of Slaanesh.
units.daemonicGifts: Allure of Slaanesh, Spirit Swallower, Siren Song

magicItems.name: Witstealer Sword
magicItems.text: Magic Weapon. Any model that suffers one or more unsaved Wounds from the Witstealer Sword must immediately pass an Initiative test or suffer another Wound with the Ignores Armour Saves special rule.

specialRulesBody.name: Bringers of Beguilement
specialRulesBody.text: If N'Kari is included in your army, you may upgrade one unit of Daemonettes to the Bringers of Beguilement for a cost of +1 point per model. All models in this unit have +1 Movement and may re-roll failed charge and pursuit distances.

specialRulesBody.name: Willing Prey
specialRulesBody.text: Enemy units in base contact with N'Kari suffer -1 to their Weapon Skill.

units.name: SHALAXI HELBANE
units.subtitle: Monarch of the Hunt
units.magic: Shalaxi Helbane is a Level 2 Wizard who uses spells from the Lore of Slaanesh

specialRulesBody.name: Irresistible Challenge
specialRulesBody.text: Enemy characters who refuses a Challenge from Shalaxi Helbane suffer D3 Strength 5 Hits which Ignores Armour saves.

magicItems.name: Soulpiercer
magicItems.text: Magic Weapon. Spear. When fighting in a Challenge, Shalaxi Helbane has the Heroic Killing Blow special rule.

magicItems.name: Shining Aegis
magicItems.text: Magic Armour. Shield. This shield gives Shalaxi Helbane the Magic Resistance (1) special rule.

magicItems.name: Cloak of Constriction
magicItems.text: Talisman. All models attempting to strike Shalaxi Helbane in close combat must pass a Strength test or lose 1 Attack.

units.name: AZAZEL
units.subtitle: Prince of Damnation
units.magic: Azazel is a Level 2 Wizard who uses spells from the Lore of Slaanesh.

magicItems.name: Daemonblade
magicItems.text: Magic Weapon. All attacks made with the Daemonblade have the Ignores Armour Saves special rule.

specialRulesBody.name: Aura of Slaanesh
specialRulesBody.text: Any enemy unit in base contact with Azazel suffers a -1 penalty to its Leadership value.

specialRulesBody.name: Dark Halo
specialRulesBody.text: Azazel may re-roll failed Magical Ward saves.

units.name: SYLL'ESSKE
units.subtitle: The Vengeful Allegiance

magicItems.name: Axe of Dominion
magicItems.text: Magic Weapon. Great weapon. All attacks made by Esske automatically Wound with the Ignores Armour saves special rule.

magicItems.name: Scourging Whip
magicItems.text: Magic Weapon. All models in base contact with Syll'Esske lose 1 Attack.

specialRulesBody.name: Deadly Symbiosis
specialRulesBody.text: For each successful To Hit roll by Syll, Esske may re-roll one failed To Hit roll the same phase.

specialRulesBody.name: Lithe and Swift
specialRulesBody.text: Syll'Esske may re-roll failed charge and pursuit rolls.

specialRulesBody.name: Subvert
specialRulesBody.text: At the start of each of your turns, one enemy Character within 12" and Line of Sight of Syll'Esske must take a Psychology test. If failed, no units can use that model's Leadership until the start of your next turn.

specialRulesBody.name: Regal Authority
specialRulesBody.text: All friendly Daemons of Slaanesh within 18" of Syll'Esske may re-roll 1's To Hit in close combat.

notes: Syll'Esske has a Line of Sight value of 4 and a Unit Strength of 5.

magicItems.name: Sceptre of Slaanesh
magicItems.text: Enchanted Item. All friendly Daemons of Slaanesh units within 12" of Dexcessa may re- roll Daemonic Instability tests.

specialRulesBody.name: Joyous Battle Fury
specialRulesBody.text: Dexcessa receive +1 Attack for each round of close combat after the first, for as a long as they remain in close combat (to a maximum of 10 Attacks total).

specialRulesBody.name: Mesmerising Lepidoptera
specialRulesBody.text: All enemy attacks targeting Dexcessa suffer a -1 penalty To Hit.

specialRulesBody.name: Redolence of Violence
specialRulesBody.text: During any turn in which Dexcessa makes a successful charge, all friendly Daemon of Slaanesh units within 12" gain +1 Attack for the duration of this turn.

units.name: SYNESSA
units.subtitle: The Voice of Slaanesh
units.magic: Synessa are a Level 4 Wizard who uses spells from the Lore of Slaanesh. In addition, she knows the following spell:

magicBody.name: Whispers of Doubt
magicBody.text: Level 1, cast on 5+. Whispers of Doubt is a hex spell with a range of 24". The target unit must take a Leadership test using an additional D6; if failed, all close combat attacks targeting that unit gain +1 To Hit until the start of your next Magic phase.

magicItems.name: Staff of Slaanesh
magicItems.text: Arcane Item. Staff. Bound Spell (Level 3, cast on 10+). This is a direct damage spell with a range of 18". The target unit suffers 2D6 Wounds. Saves are taken as normal.

units.specialRules: Daemon of Slaanesh, Fly (8), Loremaster (Lore of Slaanesh)

specialRulesBody.name: Mesmerising Lepidoptera
specialRulesBody.text: All enemy attacks targeting Synessa suffer a -1 penalty To Hit.

specialRulesBody.name: The Voice of Slaanesh
specialRulesBody.text: All friendly models within Line of Sight of Synessa may use their Leadership. In addition, any spells that Synessa casts can be targeted at any enemy unit within Line of Sight, regardless of range.

units.name: THE MASQUE OF SLAANESH
units.subtitle: Eternal Dancer
units.specialRulesBody:
• The Eternal Dance: At the start of each of the controlling player's Close Combat phases, the Masque must choose one dance to perform from the list given below. These abilities target one enemy unit (which may be in combat). Each dance has a range of 12" and does not require line of sight. Until the end of the phase, the target suffers a penalty to the characteristic stated (to a minimum of 1).
  - The Fleshspasm Polka: All models in the unit suffer -1 Strength.
  - The Waltz of Lethargy: All models in the unit suffer
  - D3 Initiative.
  - The Dance of Dreaming: All models in the unit suffer
  - D3 Leadership.
• Unnatural Reflexes: The Masque of Slaanesh has the Dodge (6+) special rule, and may re-roll failed Dodge saves.

units.name: KAIROS FATEWEAVER
units.subtitle: Oracle of Tzeentch
units.magic: Kairos Fateweaver is a Level 4 Wizard who uses spells from the Lore of Tzeentch. In addition, his left head
units.magicBody:
may choose a total of four spells from the following Lores of Magic:
• Heavens
• Life
• Light
• Metal
Kairos's right head may then choose a total of four spells from the following Lores of Magic:
• Beasts
• Death
• Fire
• Shadow
At the start of each Magic phase, decide which head Kairos is using this turn. He may only cast spells known to that head during this turn, as well as the Lore of Tzeentch.

magicItems.name: Staff of Tomorrow
magicItems.text: Arcane Item. Staff. Kairos allows you to re-roll a single D6 of your choice once per turn – declare before you make the re-roll. If this is used to re-roll a single dice from a batch of 2D6, 3D6 etc, the other dice in that batch cannot be re-rolled.

units.specialRules: Daemon of Tzeentch, Fly (8), Loremaster (Lore of Tzeentch)

specialRulesBody.name: Oracle of Eternity
specialRulesBody.text: Kairos Fateweaver has a 6+ invulnerable save.

specialRulesBody.name: The Blazing Squealers
specialRulesBody.text: If Kairos Fateweaver is included in your army, you may upgrade one unit of Pink Horrors to the Blazing Squealers for a cost of +2 points per model. The Lesser Flames of Tzeentch from this unit are resolved at Strength 4 instead of Strength 3.

units.name: AMON 'CHAKAI
units.subtitle: Lord of Change
units.magic: Amon 'Chakai is a Level 4 Wizard who uses spells from the Lore of Tzeentch.

specialRulesBody.name: Daemonic Aura
specialRulesBody.text: Amon 'Chakai and all friendly units within 6" gain +1 to their Magical Ward saves (to a maximum of 3+) against non-Magical Attacks.

specialRulesBody.name: The Hand of Destiny
specialRulesBody.text: At the start of the game, choose one enemy model. All close combat and shooting attacks against this model will automatically Hit for the remainder of the game.

units.name: THE BLUE SCRIBES
units.subtitle: Azure Arcanologists

magicItems.name: Scrolls of Sorcery
magicItems.text: Arcane Item. Relic. Bound Spell. The Blue Scribes can cast one spell from one of the eight Winds of Magic in the Warhammer rulebook during each of your Magic phases. You can choose which lore the spell is to be cast from, but must roll a D6 and refer to the spell order in their chosen Lore to see which spell is cast (the Blue Scribes can therefore never cast a signature spell). If there is no viable target or you choose not to cast the spell that has been rolled, the Blue Scribes do not cast a spell that turn – instead, add a counter as described in their Spell Syphon special rule.

specialRulesBody.name: Spell Syphon
specialRulesBody.text: Whenever an enemy successfully casts a spell (including Bound Spells), place a counter next to the Blue Scribes. At the start of your next Magic phase, the Blue Scribes can make a channelling attempt for each counter. Once the Blue Scribes have attempted to channel, remove all counters from them.

notes: The Blue Scribes have a Unit Strength of 3.

units.name: THE CHANGELING
units.subtitle: Tzeentch's Trickster
units.magic: The Changeling is a Level 1 Wizard who uses spells from the Lore of Tzeentch.

specialRulesBody.name: Formless Horror
specialRulesBody.text: At the start of each Close Combat phase, choose an enemy model in base contact with the Changeling. The Changeling may increase any or all of his Weapon Skill, Strength, Toughness, Initiative and Attacks characteristics to match those of the chosen enemy model until the end of that phase. If the chosen model has more than one value for a characteristic (as is the case with a mounted model), the Changeling may always choose the higher value. The Changeling cannot match the characteristics of an enemy that is fighting in a challenge, unless the Changeling is fighting in the same challenge.

unitConstraints.raw: You may take 1-2 Hellflayers as a single Rare choice.
Karanak may never be the Army General.

rules.name: ELVEN GRACE
rules.text: Models with this special rule have the Dodge (6+) special rule in close combat. However, this cannot be used against enemies that attack before the model with Elven Grace.

rules.name: ETERNAL HATRED
rules.text: Models with this special rule have the Hatred special rule in addition to Hatred (High Elves).

rules.name: HEKARTI'S BLESSING
rules.text: A Wizard with this special rule gains a +1 casting bonus.

rules.name: MURDEROUS PROWESS
rules.text: Models with this special rule may re-roll all To Wound rolls of 1 when making close combat attacks.

rules.name: KHAINITE
rules.text: Models who are Khainites (except models deploying using the Hidden special rule) may only join units which are also Khainites, and models who are not Khainites may not join Khainite units.

rules.name: SEA DRAGON CLOAK
rules.text: A Sea Dragon Cloak gives the wearer the Natural Armour (5+) special rule against missile attacks.

rules.name: DEATHRAIN CROSSBOW
rules.text:
Deathrain crossbows have the following profile:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
16/24" | 2 | Multiple Shots (3), Rapid Fire

rules.name: REPEATER HANDBOW
rules.text:
Repeater handbows have the following profile:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
8/12" | 2 | Multiple Shots (3), Quick Shot, Rapid Fire
tables: Multiple Shots (3), Quick Shot, Rapid Fire

items.name: DOOMSINGER
items.text: At the beginning of each round of close combat, roll a D3; the result is the number you may increase the wielder's Weapon Skill, Strength and Attacks by.

items.name: CHILLBLADE
items.text: Attacks made with the Chillblade wound automatically and have the Ice Attacks special rule. For each unsaved Wound suffered from the Chillblade, the target suffers -1 to its Attacks characteristic until the end of this Close Combat phase.

items.name: VENOMFANG BLADE
items.text: Any model that suffers an unsaved Wound from this weapon must pass a Toughness test on a 2D6 or automatically lose all remaining wounds.

items.name: EXECUTIONER'S AXE
items.text: In close combat, the wielder of the Executioner's Axe counts as having a Strength value equal to double that of their target's Toughness. In addition, any attacks made with the Executioner's Axe have the Multiple Wounds (D3) special rule. Furthermore, the wielder gains the Khainite special rule.

items.name: BLOOD BLADES
items.text: These weapon gives the wielder +1 Strength and the Multiple Wounds (D3) special rule.

items.name: SHADE CLAW
items.text: The wielder of this weapon gains the Ignores Armour saves special rule. In addition, no Parry saves may be taken against it.

items.name: DRAICH OF DARK POWER
items.text: The wielder of the Draich of Dark Power ignores the normal Initiative penalties from great weapons as well as gaining the Khainite and Killing Blow special rules.

items.name: LIFETAKER
items.text:
Lifetaker fires using the following profile:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
30" | 4 | Armour Piercing (1), Multiple Shots (3)
Lifetaker ignores all To Hit modifiers.

items.name: WEB OF SHADOWS
items.text: The model can choose to use the Web of Shadows in addition to their normal attacks. When used, one model in base contact with the character automatically takes 2D6 Strength 3 hits.

items.name: BLADE OF SPITE
items.text: Any To Hit roll of 5+ with the Blade of Spite automatically Wounds. Armour saves apply as normal. This has no effect on models with Immunity (Poisoned Attacks).

items.name: CRONE BLADE
items.text: Roll a D6 each time the wielder of this weapon (excluding mounts) causes an unsaved Wound in close combat. On the roll of a 4+, they regain 1 Wound suffered earlier during the game.

items.name: DEATHPIERCER
items.text: Attacks made with Deathpiercer have the Killing Blow special rule.

items.name: SHADESLIVER
items.text: After every round of close combat in which the bearer of this item inflicts one or more Unsaved Wounds, this weapon gains +1 Strength for the remainder of the battle. This effect is cumulative.

items.name: THE MIRROR GLAIVE
items.text: Each time an enemy spell cast at the bearer of this weapon or the unit they are with is dispelled, you may attempt to cast the same spell back as if it was a Bound Spell, using your Dispel dice as if they were Power dice. The enemy may then attempt to dispel it using their Power dice.

items.name: SHADRACAR'S FANG
items.text: The wielder of this weapon gains +1 To Hit and the Killing Blow special rule.

items.name: SOULRENDER
items.text: Attacks made with Soulrender have the Armour Piercing (1) special rule. In addition, the wielder gains the Khainite special rule.

items.name: SWORD OF RUIN
items.text: Attacks made with the Sword of Ruin have the Ignores Armour Saves special rule.

items.name: CALEDOR'S BANE
items.text: Caledor's Bane gives the wielder the Devastating Charge special rule, and attacks made with it ignore Natural Armour.

items.name: HEARTSEEKER
items.text: The model wielding Heartseeker may re-roll all failed rolls To Hit and To Wound in close combat.

items.name: HYDRA BLADE
items.text: The wielder of the Hydra Blade has the Random Attacks (D6) special rule in addition to their normal attacks.

items.name: DAGGER OF HOTEK
items.text: The Dagger of Hotek gives the wielder the Always Strikes First special rule.

items.name: ARMOUR OF ETERNAL SERVITUDE
items.text: The wearer of the Armour of Eternal Servitude gains the Regeneration (4+) special rule.

items.name: ARMOUR OF LIVING DEATH
items.text: The wearer gains +1 Toughness and +1 Wound. However, they also become subject to Stupidity.

items.name: BLOOD ARMOUR
items.text: For every unsaved wound the wearer of the Blood Armour inflicts in close combat, their armour save is improved by one point to a maximum total of 2+ for the remainder of the game.

items.name: ARMOUR OF DARKNESS
items.text: The Armour of Darkness gives the wearer a 3+ armour save and the Immunity (Armour Piercing) special rule.

items.name: CLOAK OF HAG GRAEF
items.text: Any missile attack on a model wearing the Cloak of Hag Graef has its Strength halved (rounding up) before rolling To Wound.

items.name: SHIELD OF GHROND
items.text: The Shield of Ghrond causes all Hits on the model to be resolved with -1 Strength.

items.name: THE BLACK AMULET
items.text: The wearer of the Black Amulet has the Magical Ward (4+) special rule. In addition, each time the bearer of the Black Amulet makes a successful Magical Ward save in close combat, the Black Amulet inflicts one Wound which Ignores Armour saves on the opponent that struck the blow.

items.name: RING OF HOTEK
items.text: The bearer and any unit they join have the Magic Resistance (3) special rule. Any enemy Wizard that attempts to cast or target a spell on a unit within 12" of the bearer will suffer a miscast on a roll of double 6, as well as double 1.

items.name: PENDANT OF KHAELETH
items.text: Roll a D6 for every wound suffered by the wearer; on a roll lower than the Strength of the Attack, the Wound is ignored. Rolls of 6 always fail.

items.name: CROWN OF BLACK IRON
items.text: The Crown of Black Iron gives the bearer +1 Leadership as well as the Magical Ward (5+) and Magic Resistance (1) special rules.

items.name: RING OF DARKNESS
items.text: The Ring of Darkness causes all close combat attacks directed against the bearer to be resolved at half their normal Weapon Skill (rounding up). Any missile attacks directed at the model or their unit resolved at half their normal Ballistic Skill (rounding up).

items.name: HEART-STONE OF DARKNESS
items.text: The Heart-stone of Darkness gives the bearer the Magical Ward (4+) special rule against close combat attacks.

items.name: CLOAK OF TWILIGHT
items.text: Enemy units cannot charge or target the bearer with missile attacks or spells if they are more than 12" away from them. Within 12", they can only be charged or targeted by first rolling a 4+ on a D6. If the test is failed, the unit may choose a new target as normal.

items.name: SHADOWSHROUD RING
items.text: This ring may be used at the start of any of your turns. Until the start of your next turn, no enemy units can declare a charge or target the unit with spells or missile attacks unless they are within 6" of the bearer of this item.

items.name: SEAL OF GHROND
items.text: The Seal of Ghrond adds +1 Dispel dice to your dispel pool at the start of every enemy Magic phase.

items.name: AMBER AMULET
items.text: The wearer of the Amber Amulet gains the Regeneration (5+) special rule.

items.name: INCORPOREAL RETAINER
items.text: All enemy models attacking the bearer of this item must re-roll successful rolls To Hit.

items.name: CHARM OF HOTEK
items.text: The model wearing the Charm of Hotek gains a 6+ Armour Save and the Immunity (Flaming Attacks) special rule.

items.name: NULL TALISMAN
items.text: Any dispel attempt made against enemy spells targeting the model carrying this item, or any unit they are with, gains a +3 dispel bonus.

items.name: BLACK STAFF
items.text: Whenever the bearer casts a spell, they may add an additional free power dice to the result after rolling the dice. However, if this extra dice rolls a 1, the Wizard suffers 1 Wound which Ignores Armour Saves.

items.name: SHADOW STONE
items.text: When casting spells from the Lore of Shadow, the Wizard gains a +1 casting bonus and may re-roll a single roll of a natural 1 per casting attempt.

items.name: DARKSTAR CLOAK
items.text: The Darkstar Cloak gives the Wizard +D3 Power dice in each of your Magic phases. Only they may use these extra dice.

items.name: THE SACRIFICIAL DAGGER
items.text: Once per casting attempt, after the casting dice are rolled but before a dispel attempt is made, the bearer of this magic item can sacrifice one model in her unit. Choose which model is sacrificed – it is immediately removed as a casualty with no saves of any kind allowed – then roll a D6. On a 2+, the Sorceress gains an extra power dice that must be rolled and added to the casting result; dispel attempts can now be made and the spell resolved. This can be used to allow the Wizard to use more dice than is normally allowed by their Wizard level. On a roll of a 1, the sacrifice has not generated enough power – you can either immediately sacrifice another model from the unit and roll again, following the procedure above, or accept the original casting result (if the bearer is the only model remaining in the unit, no further sacrifices can be attempted).

items.name: SOULSTONE
items.text: The Soulstone makes the Sorceress immune to the effects of her first Miscast.

items.name: FOCUS FAMILIAR
items.text: The Focus Familiar allows the wielder to cast spells from a different position on the battlefield. Place a marker no more than 1" in diameter at the start of each Dark Elf Magic phase within 6" of the Wizard and at least 1" away from units or impassable terrain. They may use this position when determining range and line of sight (at 360°) for their spells for remainder of each Magic phase.

items.name: THE GEM OF SPITE
items.text: Whenever the bearer suffers a miscast, the Gem of Spite inflicts a single Strength 6 hit on every enemy Wizard within 18".

items.name: ORB OF GHROND
items.text: The model carrying the Orb of Ghrond may consult it at the start of each of your turns as long as they are not in close combat. If they do so, they become subject to the Stupidity special rule for the remainder of the turn. However, the model may also re- roll one power or dispel dice when casting or dispelling until the start of your next turn.

items.name: TOME OF FURION
items.text: The bearer of the Tome of Furion gains the Loremaster (Lore of Dark Magic) special rule.

items.name: WAND OF THE KHARAIDON
items.text: When casting the Doombolt spell from the Lore of Dark Magic, you may re-roll the number of Hits caused.

items.name: ANKLET OF EPIPHANY
items.text: The bearer of this item gains +6" to the range of their spells (except auras) if they are within 6" of a terrain feature.

items.name: CRYSTAL HEART
items.text: The bearer of this item may choose to attempt to cast one spell twice per Magic phase. However, every time they choose to do so, roll a D6 first. On the roll of a 1, the model suffers a Wound which Ignores Armour saves.

items.name: RUBRIC OF DARK DIMENSIONS
items.text: The Rubric of Dark Dimensions contains a direct damage spell which targets all enemy models in base contact with the caster. The target models must pass a Strength test for each Wound on their profile or suffer a Wound which Ignores Armour Saves.

items.name: ASPHYXICA CENSER
items.text: At the start of each round of close combat, all enemy models in base contact with the bearer must take a Toughness test or suffer a Wound with no saves allowed.

items.name: CROWN OF WOE
items.text: Enemy units cannot use the Inspiring Presence special rule while they are within 6" of the bearer of this item. After the bearer has slain one or more models in close combat, the range is increased to 12" for the remainder of the game.

items.name: DECANTER OF EGOS
items.text: All friendly units within 6" of the bearer gain +1 to their Movement characteristic.

items.name: PEARL OF INFINITE BLEAKNESS
items.text: The model bearing the Pearl of Infinite Bleakness and any unit they are with gain the Immunity (Psychology) special rule. In addition, any enemy unit in base contact with the bearer suffers -1 to their Leadership.

items.name: BLACK DRAGON EGG
items.text: The bearer may consume this item at the start of any player turn. For the rest of that turn, the consumer has Strength and Toughness 6, and the Noxious Breath (see Black Dragons) special rule.

items.name: DEATHMASK
items.text: The wearer of the Deathmask causes Terror.

items.name: THE HYDRA'S TEETH
items.text: The Hydra's Teeth can be used at the start of any close combat phase. Once used, they inflict 5D6 Weapon Skill 2, Strength 3 Attacks on one enemy unit in base contact.

items.name: THE GUIDING EYE
items.text: The bearer of the Guiding Eye and any unit they are with may re-roll 1's To Hit with missile weapons.

items.name: CRYSTAL OF MIDNIGHT
items.text: Nominate one enemy Wizard within 12" at the start of any of their Magic phases. The Wizard must pass a Leadership test or lose one randomly determined spell for the rest of the battle.

items.name: THE CLOAK OF DARK SOULS
items.text: The wearer of the Cloak of Dark Souls gains the Hidden and Scouts special rules.

items.name: GEM OF NIGHTMARES
items.text: The Gem of Nightmares can be used at the start of any turn. Until the end of that turn, the model and any unit it is with has the Terror special rule.

items.name: SEVENFOLD SHADOW
items.text: Instead of moving normally in the Remaining Moves sub-phase, the model may be moved to anywhere on the battlefield, as long as they do not end their move within 6" of any enemy unit or 1" of impassable terrain.

items.name: SEA SERPENT STANDARD
items.text: The unit carrying this standard gains the Frenzy special rule.

items.name: SACRIFICIAL BANNER
items.text: All enemy Monstrous Creatures or Monsters with Line of Sight to the unit carrying this standard gain the Berserk Rage portion of the Frenzy special rule against it. In addition, they suffer a -3 Leadership modifier for any Berserk Rage tests against the unit bearing this standard.

items.name: DREAD BANNER
items.text: The unit carrying this standard gains the Fear special rule.

items.name: STANDARD OF SLAUGHTER
items.text: The unit carrying this standard gains +D3 to their combat resolution bonus on any turn the unit charges.

items.name: SOUL SHADOWS STANDARD
items.text: If the unit carrying this standard chooses Flee as a charge reaction it automatically rallies at the end of their Flee move (as long as the charging unit does not reach it).

items.name: TRAITOR'S BANNER
items.text: Enemy units attempting to target the unit carrying this standard with missile attacks or spells must pass a Leadership test. If failed, they must choose another target. If no other target is available, they cannot choose to cast that spell this turn.

items.name: BANNER OF NAGARYTHE
items.text: All friendly units of Dark Elves within 12" of this standard gain the Eternal Hatred special rule.

items.name: HYDRA BANNER
items.text: All models in the unit carrying this standard gain +1 Attack in the first round of any close combat.

items.name: STANDARD OF HAG GRAEF
items.text: The unit carrying this standard gains the Always Strikes First special rule.

items.name: STANDARD OF HAR GANETH
items.text: The unit carrying this standard causes Terror.

items.name: BANNER OF COLD BLOOD
items.text: The unit carrying this standard gains the Cold-Blooded special rule.

items.name: BANNER OF MURDER
items.text: The unit carrying this standard adds an additional D6" to their charge range.

items.name: THE BLOOD BANNER
items.text: The unit carrying this banner are not subject to Stupidity caused by Cold Ones.

upgrades.name: DANCE OF DOOM
upgrades.text: Enemies targeting the model must re-roll all successful To Hit rolls with missile weapons and in close combat.

upgrades.name: CRY OF WAR
upgrades.text: All enemy units in base contact with the wearer suffer -1 To Hit in the first round of close combat.

upgrades.name: RENDING STARS
upgrades.text:
Rending Stars are missile weapons with the following profile.
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
6/9" | As user +1 | Multiple Shots (3), Quick Shot

upgrades.name: WITCHBREW
upgrades.text: This model, and all models in the same unit, gain the Frenzy special rule and can never lose their Frenzy.

upgrades.name: BLACK LOTUS
upgrades.text: Each unsaved Wound caused in Close Combat counts as two for the purpose of combat resolution. This has no effect against models with Immunity (Poisoned Attacks).

upgrades.name: HAND OF KHAINE
upgrades.text: All enemy units in base contact suffer a -1 penalty to their Weapon Skill and Initiative.

upgrades.name: RUNE OF KHAINE
upgrades.text: The model gains the Random Attacks (D3) special rule in addition to its normal attacks.

upgrades.name: BLOOD SIGIL
upgrades.text: The model may re-roll failed Leadership tests when using Blood Rites. However, if they roll any doubles on the second roll, they will suffer a Wound which Ignores Armour Saves.

upgrades.name: DARK VENOM
upgrades.text: A model with Dark Venom gains the Multiple Wounds (D3) special rule (including missile attacks). This has no effect against models with Immunity (Poisoned Attacks).

upgrades.name: MANBANE
upgrades.text: A model with Manbane will automatically Wound on the roll of a 2+ (including missile attacks). This has no effect against models with Immunity (Poisoned Attacks).

upgrades.name: TOUCH OF DEATH
upgrades.text: The model gains the Killing Blow special rule.

upgrades.name: KHAINITE PENDANT
upgrades.text: The model may attempt to use two Blood Rites this turn.

spells.name: SPITEFUL CONJURATION
spells.text: When a Wizard successfully casts a hex, magic missile or direct damage spell from this lore, and the casting roll contains any double, the spell's target unit suffers 2D6 Strength 2 hits after the spell has been resolved. If the casting roll contains any treble, the spell's target unit instead suffers 3D6 hits instead.

spells.name: DOOMBOLT OF KHARAIDON
spells.text: Doombolt of Kharaidon is a magic missile with a range of 18" that causes D6 Strength 5 hits.

spells.name: DEATH SPASM
spells.text: Death Spasm is a direct damage spell with a range of 18" that targets a single enemy model (even a character in a unit). The target must take D3 Toughness tests. Each failed Toughness test causes a Wound which Ignores Armour Saves. In addition, all models in base contact with the target suffer a Hit at the target's base Strength.

spells.name: NAGAELYTHE THE CHILLWIND
spells.text: Nagaelythe the Chillwind is a magic missile with a range of 24" that causes 2D6 Strength 2 hits. If the target suffers any unsaved Wounds, all models in the unit suffer a -1 penalty to their Ballistic Skill characteristic until the start of the caster's next Magic phase.

spells.name: SHADOW DAGGERS
spells.text: Shadow Daggers is a magic missile with a range of 12" that causes D6 Strength 3 Hits with the Armour Piercing (1) special rule on all enemy units in the caster's front arc.

spells.name: SAP STRENGTH
spells.text: Sap Strength is a hex spell with a range of 24". All models in the target unit suffer -1 to their Strength (to a minimum of 1) until the start of the caster's next Magic phase.

spells.name: BLADEWIND
spells.text: Bladewind is a direct damage area spell with a range of 18" that uses the large round template. All models hit by the template must pass a Weapon Skill test or suffer a Strength 4 hit.

spells.name: POWER OF DARKNESS
spells.text: Power of Darkness is an augment spell with a range of 18". All models in the target unit gain +1 Strength until the start of the caster's next Magic phase. In addition, add D3 power dice to your power pool. If a natural 6 is rolled when generating these power dice, the caster suffers a Wound which Ignores Armour saves.

spells.name: TENEBRAEL BLADES
spells.text: Tenebrael Blades is an augment spell with a range of 18". The target gains the Armour Piercing (2) and Magical Attacks special rule until the start of the caster's next Magic phase.

spells.name: CHROESH – WORD OF PAIN
spells.text: Chroesh – Word of Pain is a hex spell with a range of 24". The target unit gains the Always Strikes Last special rule until the start of the caster's next Magic phase.

spells.name: SHROUD OF DESPAIR
spells.text: Remains in play. Shroud of Despair is a hex aura with a range of 12". While the spell is in effect, the affected units cannot benefit from the Hold Your Ground or Inspiring Presence special rules. In addition, whenever an affected unit fails a Break, Panic or Terror test, all target units suffer -1 to their Leadership (this effect is cumulative).

spells.name: OBLIVION
spells.text: Oblivion is a direct damage aura spell with a range of 6". Each model (friend and foe, except the caster) within range (even if they are engaged in close combat) suffers a Strength 5 Hit.

spells.name: ANCHAN-ROGAR THE SOUL STEALER
spells.text: Anchan-Rogar the Soul Stealer is a direct damage spell with a range of 24". All models in the unit suffer a Wound on the roll of a 5+ which Ignores Armour Saves. Roll a D6 for each unsaved Wound inflicted by this spell. For each roll of 5+, the caster immediately gains a single Wound (to a maximum of 10).

spells.name: ARNZIPAL'S BLACK HORROR
spells.text: Remains in play. Arnzipal's Black Horror is a magical vortex that uses the small round template. Any model touched by the template at any point during its move must pass a Strength test per Wound on their profile or suffer a Wound which Ignores Armour Saves and Regeneration.

units.specialRulesBody:
• Orgy of Slaughter: The model and any unit they join gain the Hatred special rule.
• Blood Rites: A model with this special rule knows the three Blood Rites listed below. Unless fleeing, they may attempt to use one at the start of each of your turns by taking a Leadership test on their own unmodified Leadership. If passed, the prayer is answered and takes immediate effect. Each Blood Rite lasts until the start of your next turn. A friendly unit can only be under the effect of one Blood Rite at a time.
  - Catechism of Murder: Whenever a model in the unit causes an unsaved Wound close combat, they may immediately make an additional Attack (including supporting attacks). This additional Attack cannot generate further Attacks.
  - Crimson Rejuvenation: All models in the unit gain the Regeneration (6+) special rule.
  - Sacrament of Blood: All models in the unit gain the Swiftstride special rule.

specialRulesBody.name: Fight and Flight
specialRulesBody.text: In any close combat phase in which a unit with this special rule does not break or break their enemy, it may choose to disengage from combat instead of doing a combat reform (if the unit lost the combat they must pass a Leadership test just like when attempting to Reform from Defeat). If the unit manages to disengage from combat, the unit will make a Flee move as if it had broken from combat. This Flee move follows the rules for Feigned Flight. After finishing its move, the unit rallies automatically. The enemy unit is not allowed to Pursue, but may make a Combat Reform as normal.

units.subtitle: The Witch King of Naggaroth
units.magic: Malekith is a Level 4 Wizard who chooses spells from the Lore of Dark Magic.

magicItems.name: Destroyer
magicItems.text: Magic Weapon. At the start of every Close Combat phase, all enemy models in base contact with Malekith must reveal their magic items. Furthermore, if Malekith scores one or more hits against a model with any magic items, roll a D6; on a 4+, one randomly determined magic item is immediately destroyed and cannot be used further in this game. Do not include Magic items that are mounts, magic items that contain bound spells that miscast earlier in the game, or any magic items labelled as 'one use only' that have been used. In addition, if a Wizard suffers one or more unsaved Wounds from Destroyer, roll a D6; on a 4+, the Wizard immediately loses a Wizard level.

magicItems.name: Hand of Khaine
magicItems.text: Magic Weapon. The Hand of Khaine gives Malekith an extra Attack at Strength 6 which Ignores armour saves.

magicItems.name: Armour of Midnight
magicItems.text: Magic Armour. Heavy armour. The Armour of Midnight grants Malekith a 2+ invulnerable save against all non-magical attacks and the Immunity (Killing Blow/Multiple Wounds) special rule.

magicItems.name: Supreme Spellshield
magicItems.text: Magic Armour. Shield. This item grants Malekith the Magic Resistance (2) special rule. If Malekith is ever the target of an enemy spell that he successfully dispels, the caster's unit immediately suffers D6 magical Strength 6 hits.

magicItems.name: Circlet of Iron
magicItems.text: Arcane Item. Relic. Once per Magic phase, Malekith can use the Circlet of Iron to add a single bonus dice to any of his failed casting or dispel attempts. This bonus dice can contribute to Ultimate Power or Miscast as normal.

magicItems.name: Beast Armour of Clar Karond
magicItems.text: Magic Armour. Heavy armour. This armour allows Rakarth to re-roll failed armour saves.

units.specialRules: Beastslaver (see Beastmaster), Hatred (High Elves), Fly (7), Murderous Prowess, Natural
units.specialRulesBody:
Armour (3+), Noxious Breath (see Black Dragon)
• Beastlord: Any friendly Monster within 12" of Rakarth treat him as having the Hold Your Ground! special rule. In addition, his Beastslaver special rule affects Bracchus.
• Ravagers of Rakarth: If Rakarth is included in your army, you may upgrade any Scourgerunner Chariots to the Ravagers of Rakarth for a cost of +5 points per model. These models gain the Poisoned Attacks special rule.

units.name: KRETHUSA THE CRONESEER
units.subtitle: Prophetess of Morai-Heg
units.magic: Krethusa is a Level 3 Wizard who uses the Lore of Shadow. In addition, she knows the knows the Flock of Doom spell from the Lore of Beasts.
units.specialRules: Elven Grace, Fly (10), Hatred (High Elves), Hekarti's Blessing, Murderous Prowess
units.specialRulesBody:
• Burnt Offerings: Krethusa knows the three prophecies listed below. She may attempt to use one at the start of each of your Magic phases by taking a Leadership test on her own unmodified Leadership If passed, the prophecy is fulfilled and takes immediate effect. Each prophecy targets one friendly unit within 12".
  - Prophecy of Silence: Enemy units within 6" of the unit cannot benefit from the Inspiring Presence, Hold Your Ground or Command Group bonuses.
  - Prophecy of Dark Wings: The unit may immediately make an additional move as if it were the Remaining Moves sub-phase.
  - Prophecy of Reclamation: Enemy units in base contact with the unit do not gain Combat Resolution bonuses from anything except the number of Wounds inflicted unless they contain at least one character.
• Foresight of Morai-Heg: Krethusa has a 4+ invulnerable save.

units.name: KOURAN DARKHAND
units.subtitle: Captain of the Black Guard

magicItems.name: Crimson Death
magicItems.text: Magic Weapon. Polearm. Close combat attacks made with the Crimson Death are resolved at an additional +1 Strength.

magicItems.name: The Armour of Grief
magicItems.text: Magic Armour. Heavy armour. Each time a model makes a successful To Hit roll against Kouran Darkhand in close combat, the model that struck the blow immediately suffers a Strength 5 hit.

units.specialRules: Elven Grace, Eternal Hatred, Immunity (Psychology), Murderous Prowess, Stubborn

specialRulesBody.name: The Right Hand of Darkness
specialRulesBody.text: If Kouran Darkhand is in a unit of Black Guard, he and all models in that unit have the Unbreakable special rule.

units.name: TULLARIS DREADBRINGER
units.subtitle: The Hand of Khaine

magicItems.name: The First Draich
magicItems.text: Magic Weapon. Great weapon. Tullaris' Killing Blow special rule takes effect on a 5+, rather than a 6.

units.specialRules: Elven Grace, Hatred (High Elves), Fear, Frenzy, Khainite, Killing Blow, Murderous
units.specialRulesBody:
Prowess
• Blades of the Blood Queen: Tullaris must be accompanied by a unit of Har Ganeth Executioners chosen from the army list at a cost of +1 point per model. This unit has the Frenzy special rule. Tullaris may never choose to leave this unit.
• Khaine's Sacred Slaughterer: Each time Tullaris inflicts a successful Killing Blow, he and his unit gain a +1 bonus to their combat resolution score, in addition to any wounds inflicted by him.

units.name: LOKHIR FELLHEART
units.subtitle: Krakenlord of Karond Kar

magicItems.name: The Red Blades
magicItems.text: Magic Weapon. Two hand weapons. Any hits made by the Red Blades re-roll any failed To Wound roll.

magicItems.name: Helm of the Kraken
magicItems.text: Magic Armour. The Helm of the Kraken grants Lokhir Fellheart a 6+ armour save, +1 Toughness, as well as the Regeneration (6+) and Terror special rules.

units.specialRules: Ambushers, At them, you Curs! (see Black Ark Fleetmaster), Elven Grace, Hatred (High
units.specialRulesBody:
Elves), Murderous Prowess, Show no Weakness (see Black Ark Fleetmaster)
• Murderous Swashbuckler: If Lokhir makes a successful Parry save, he may immediately make an additional Attack back against the model that struck the blow.
• Merciless Slaver: If an enemy unit breaks from a close combat that includes Lokhir Fellheart, all units taking Panic tests as a result of that unit breaking suffer a -1 penalty to their Leadership value for that test.

units.name: SHADOWBLADE
units.subtitle: Master of Assassins, the Death that Walks Unseen

magicItems.name: Heart of Woe
magicItems.text: Enchanted Item. If Shadowblade is ever slain, centre the small round template over him before removing the model as a casualty. Every model touched by the template immediately suffers a Strength 3 hit. After any damage has been resolved, remove Shadowblade as a casualty as normal.

magicItems.name: Potion of Diabolic Strength
magicItems.text: Enchanted Item. One use only. The Potion of Diabolic Strength can be drunk at the start of any player's Close Combat phase, after any Hidden models have revealed that they are hiding in a unit. Shadowblade gains +3 Strength until the end of the turn.

units.giftsOfKhaine: Black Lotus, Dance of Doom, Dark Venom, Hand of Khaine, Manbane, Touch of Death
units.specialRules: Dodge (5+), Hatred (High Elves), Hidden, Immunity (Psychology), Khainite, Murderous
units.specialRulesBody:
Prowess, Poisoned Attacks, Scouts
• Master of Disguise: Shadowblade can deploy using the Hidden special rule like an Assassin. If he does so, he can change which unit he is hiding in at the start of any Movement or Close Combat phase – keep a note of where Shadowblade is each time you change your mind. If an opponent has an ability that forces you to state that there are 'hidden' models within a unit, you only need to say that Shadowblade is hiding within a unit, but not which unit he is currently in.

unitConstraints.raw: A High Gladiatrix may never be the Army General.
A Melusai Ironscale may never be the Army General.
You must include one Slave Master for every 20 Slaves in the unit.

rules.name: BACKSTABBERS
rules.text: A unit with this special rule that successfully restrains from pursuing after breaking an enemy unit in close combat causes D6 Strength 3 hits on the fleeing unit for every complete rank the Hobgoblin unit has (up to a maximum of 3). Resolve any casualties before moving the fleeing unit.

rules.name: COWARDLY DESPOILERS
rules.text: Models with this special rule gain +1 To Hit in the first round of combat if they successfully charge an enemy in the rear or flank.

rules.name: CUNNING RETREAT
rules.text: When an enemy unit declares to fire at a unit with this special rule in their Shooting phase, it may choose to make a Feigned Flight move directly away from the enemy unit shooting at it. Once the unit has completed its move, the enemy unit may continue with its shooting as declared (provided they are still in range).

rules.name: DED SHOOTY
rules.text: Mounted models with this special rule do not suffer penalties To Hit for Moving and Shooting and may Volley Fire even while moving.

rules.name: DUCK & WEAVE
rules.text: Enemies attacking Infantry models with this special rule suffer -1 To Hit in close combat.

rules.name: ELVEN GRACE
rules.text: Models with this special rule have the Dodge (6+) special rule in close combat. However, this cannot be used against enemies that attack before the model with Elven Grace.

rules.name: MERCENARIES
rules.text:
Every time a unit with this special rule fails a Break test, roll on the Mercenary Loyalty table below and apply the results. This rule has no effect on a unit that is joined by the Army General or Paymaster.
D6 | Result
1-3 | Wavering Loyalty: The unit flees as normal, and all models in the unit suffer a -1 modifier to their Leadership for the rest of the battle.
4-5 | Soldier On: The unit flees as normal.
6 | Stand Fast! The unit has the Disciplined special rule on their next Rally test.
tables: Wavering Loyalty: The unit flees as normal, and all models in the unit suffer a -1 modifier to their Leadership for the rest of the battle.
Soldier On: The unit flees as normal.
Stand Fast! The unit has the Disciplined special rule on their next Rally test.

rules.name: OGRE CHARGE
rules.text: The model has the Impact Hits (1) special rule. In addition, they add their current Rank Bonus to the Strength of the Impact Hits they inflict. In addition, they count as having one more rank than their actual number for the purpose of determining Steadfast in any turn that they charge.

rules.name: RACIAL DISTRUST
rules.text: Most models belong to a certain race as detailed in their Troop Type. This includes Human, Dwarf, Elf, Halfling, Ogre, Orc and Hobgoblin. Characters may only join units belonging to the same race. Only a Human character may be the Army General.

rules.name: RELENTLESS
rules.text: Units entirely composed of models with this special rule do not need to pass a Leadership test in order to march, regardless of the proximity of enemy units.

rules.name: RESOLUTE
rules.text: When taking Break tests, models with this special rule count as having lost the combat with 1 point fewer than they actually have.

rules.name: DWARFEN CROSSBOW
rules.text:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
30/36" | 4 | Ponderous

rules.name: DWARFEN PISTOL
rules.text:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
9/12" | 5 | Quick Shot

rules.name: ELVEN SHORTBOW
rules.text:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
16/24" | 3 | Armour Piercing (1), March & Shoot Multiple Shots (2)*, Volley Fire
*Only applies in turns the model has not marched. Cannot be used as a charge reaction.
tables: Armour Piercing (1), March & Shoot Multiple Shots (2)*, Volley Fire

rules.name: ELVEN LONGBOW
rules.text:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
24/36" | 3 | Armour Piercing (1), Multiple Shots (2)*, Volley Fire
*Only applies in turns the model has not moved. Cannot be used as a charge reaction.
tables: Armour Piercing (1), Multiple Shots (2)*, Volley Fire

rules.name: GUT-PLATE
rules.text: A model with a gut-plate gains a 6+ armour save against attacks to the front.

rules.name: IRONFIST
rules.text: Buckler. If a model with an ironfist rolls a natural 6 when making a Parry save, it automatically inflicts an extra Hit back onto the model or unit that struck the blow.

rules.name: OGRE PISTOLS
rules.text:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
12/24" | 5 | Multiple Shots (2)*, Quick Shot
*Requires a brace of Ogre pistols.

rules.name: ORIENTAL LONGSWORD
rules.text:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
Combat | As user | Parry (6+), Requires Two Hands
An Oriental Longsword gives the wielder +1 To Wound.

rules.name: PAVISE
rules.text:
A Pavise has the following armour profile:
COMBAT | MISSILE | SPECIAL RULES
- | +3/4+* | -
*Only applies to missile attacks in the front arc.

items.name: HURCIO'S CLUB
items.text: Requires two hands. The wielder of this club adds +1 to his Strength and Attacks at the start of each close combat phase (up to a maximum of +3), for as long as he remains in combat.

items.name: CATHAYAN DRAGONSWORD
items.text:
The Dragonsword gives the wielder +1 Weapon Skill, +1 Initiative as well as the Killing Blow, Armour Piercing (1) and Flaming Attacks special rules.
DOMINGO'S ARBALEST 45 points Mercenary General or Mercenary Captain only. This is a bolt thrower with the following profile:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
24/36" | 5 | Armour Piercing (1), Multiple Wounds (D3), Ponderous

items.name: DAWNSTAR SWORD
items.text: The wielder of this weapon doubles their Attacks characteristic.

items.name: GRUDGEBRINGER SWORD
items.text: All attacks made with the Grudgebringer Sword gain +1 To Hit and have the Flaming Attacks special rule. In addition, it contains the Fireball spell from the Lore of Fire as a Bound Spell.

items.name: PIKE OF REMAS
items.text: This weapon inflicts D3 Strength 5 Impact Hits when the wielder is charged to their front. In addition, it has the Heroic Killing Blow special rule against Cavalry and Monstrous Cavalry. This item can be taken despite Mercenary Captains not normally being allowed to take pikes.

items.name: SWORD OF ANTI-HEROES
items.text: The wielder gains +1 Strength and +1 Attack for every enemy character in base contact with them or their unit. These bonuses are calculated at the start of each round of close combat and last until its end.

items.name: SILVERSTONE AXE
items.text: The wielder always treats their Strength as at least 1 point higher than their opponent's Toughness and has the Multiple Wounds (D3) special rule. In addition, any Wizard that suffers one or more Wounds from this weapon must immediately roll on the Miscast table.

items.name: CACKLING BLADE
items.text: This weapon gives the wielder +D6 Attacks at the start of each round of close combat. However, if they roll a natural 6 when determining the number of Attacks they get, they suffer a Hit at their own Strength value as well.

items.name: COLD IRON BLADE
items.text: The Cold Iron Blade gives +1 Strength to the wielder. Against models with the Ethereal special rule, it automatically Wounds.

items.name: BLADE OF PRESCIENT PERFECTION
items.text: All attacks with this weapon automatically Hit.

items.name: SWORD OF SORROW
items.text:
This weapon has the following profile:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
30" | 5 | Multiple Wounds (2)
No saves are allowed against Wounds caused by this weapon.

items.name: METEOR HAMMER
items.text: This weapon automatically Wounds on the roll of a 2+.

items.name: BLADE OF LAST RESORT
items.text: The wielder must always accept challenges if possible. While they are fighting in a challenge, they gain +D3 to their Weapon Skill, Strength, Toughness, Initiative and Attacks (roll once and apply the result to all characteristics for the duration of the challenge). If the wielder slays their opponent in the challenge, they suffer D3 Wounds themselves with no saves allowed.

items.name: TORMENTOR SWORD
items.text: A monster or character that suffers an unsaved wound from the Tormentor sword has the Stupidity special rule for the rest of the game.

items.name: WARRIOR BANE
items.text: A monster or character that suffers unsaved wounds from Warrior Bane permanently loses one Attack for each unsaved wound (to a minimum of 1 Attack).

items.name: GIANTKIN HELM
items.only: Mercenary General or Mercenary Captain on foot
items.text: This item gives the wearer a 6+ armour save. In addition, it can be used at the start of any of your turns. When used, the model turns into a Giant (see Rare Units). If they are in a unit, they must be placed 1" to the side, facing the same direction. While transformed, the model cannot cast spells, nor use any equipment or other magic items. If you do not have a suitable model to place, this item has no effect. At the start of each subsequent turn, roll a D6. On a 1, the model is turned back into their normal profile. Any Wounds suffered while in Giant form are retaining, even if this kills the wearer.

items.name: HELM OF MYRMIDIA
items.text: This item gives the wearer a 6+ armour save. Enemies attacking the wearer in Close Combat suffer -1 to Hit and lose 1 Attack, down to a minimum of 1. In addition, the wearer gains the Hatred (Undead) special rule.

items.name: MAMBRINIO'S GOLDEN ARMOUR
items.text: The wearer gains +2 to their armour save and the Immunity (Multiple Wounds) special rule. However, they suffer -2 Initiative and a -1 penalty to Dangerous Terrain tests.

items.name: HELM OF DISCORD
items.text: This item gives the wearer a 6+ armour save. In addition, at the start of each Close Combat phase, choose an enemy character in base contact with the bearer or his unit. That character must immediately take a Leadership test. If the test is failed, the victim cannot make attacks and is hit automatically in this Close Combat round.

items.name: SHIELD OF PTOLOS
items.text: The bearer has a 2+ armour save against shooting attacks.

items.name: SHIELD OF STUBBORN REFUSAL
items.text: The bearer is always Steadfast in the first round of combat. In addition, if they are with a unit that would otherwise flee as a result of a failed break test that the bearer would normally pass, the bearer will remain in combat while the rest of the unit flees.

items.name: HELM OF THE HEADLESS HORSEMAN
items.text: This item gives the wearer a 6+ armour save. In addition, the wearer gains the Flaming Attacks and Killing Blow special rules. However, they must roll a D6 at the start of each of your turns. On the roll of a 1, the model suffers a Wound with no saves allowed.

items.name: LEVITATING SHIELD
items.text: The wielder may use this shield and a weapon that Requires Two Hands at the same time.

items.name: GUARDIAN AMULET
items.text: The bearer gains a Magical Ward (2+). Roll separately for every wound suffered. For every successful save you make, the Magical Ward will weaken for the rest of the game, so after one save it will be a 3+, after two saves a 4+ etc. until a minimum of a 6+ save.

items.name: WARDS OF BATTLE
items.text: The bearer has a Magical Ward (4+) against close combat attacks.

items.name: DASHING CLOAK OF HEROIC RENOWN
items.text: The bearer gains the Regeneration (5+) special rule.

items.name: ICON OF FORTITUDE
items.text: The bearer of this item gains +1 Toughness.

items.name: MASTER DUELLIST'S MARK
items.text: The bearer gains the Dodge (6+) and Parry (6+) special rules.

items.name: HOURGLASS OF MORR
items.text: At the beginning of the game, write down a number in secret. This is the turn number when the bearer of this item cannot be reduced below 1 Wound or removed as a casualty, unless they are caught when fleeing.

items.name: IRONCURSE ICON
items.text: The bearer and any unit they are with gain a Magical Ward (6+) against artillery weapons.

items.name: IRONHIDE TALISMAN
items.text: All missile attacks targeting the bearer of this item must re-roll 6's To Wound with missile attacks.

items.name: SHARD OF MORRSLIEB
items.text: The model gains the Immunity (Killing Blow/Poisoned Attacks/Lore of Death) special rule.

items.name: WINDCATCHER PRISM
items.text: This item contains the Signature Spells from all the eight Winds of Magic. Note that you may only attempt to cast one each Magic phase.

items.name: THE WHITE SISTRUM
items.text: The bearer gains +1 Power Dice at the start of your Magic phase. In addition, all enemy units within 6" suffer -1 to their Leadership.

items.name: THE CRUCIBLE OF HORRORS
items.text: This item contains a direct damage spell. The caster makes a Breath Weapon attack. This may be cast in close combat, following the normal rules for Breath Weapons. All models Hit suffer a hit with a Strength value of 2D6 (roll once per cast) minus the target's Toughness and the Ignores Armour Saves special rule. However, every time this spell is successfully cast, the bearer must pass a Leadership test on their own unmodified Leadership or suffer a Wound with no saves allowed.

items.name: ROCKCHARMER'S FLUTE
items.text: This is special type of spell. Choose a hill within 18". Any unit on it suffers 2D6 Strength 4 Hits. The hill is then moved 2D6" in a direction of your choice, stopping within 1" of any impassable terrain.

items.name: SIVEJIR'S HEX SCROLL
items.text: When an enemy spell has been cast, a Wizard who has a Hex Scroll can read it instead of attempting to dispel the spell. The spell is cast as normal, but a portion of the spell's energy is transformed and redirected at the caster. The enemy wizard can resist the spell's effects by rolling equal to or under his wizard level on a D6. If failed, the wizard cannot channel or cast spells, all of his magic items and mundane equipment (armour, weapons, etc.) temporarily stop working and all of their characteristics are reduced to 1 (except for his wounds, which are unaffected). Their controlling player can roll a D6 at the start of each of his subsequent magic phases; the spell dissipates on a roll of 4+ and the wizard returns to their normal form.

items.name: STAFF OF FICKLE FORTUNE
items.text: At the beginning of each of your magic phases, roll a D6; on a roll of 1 the bearer suffers -D3 to his casting rolls (roll for each spell) for the remainder of the turn; on a roll of 2 nothing happens; on a 3+ however, the wizard gains +D3 to all his casting attempts (roll for each spell) for the remainder of the turn.

items.name: STAFF OF QUIETUDE
items.text: Bound Spell (Level 2, cast on 7 +). This is a special aura spell with a range of 24". If successfully cast, all Remains in Play spells and spells that last more than one turn within range are immediately dispelled and cease to have any effect.

items.name: BOOK OF ASHUR
items.text: The Wizard gains the Loremaster special rule. This has no effect on models that can choose spells from more than one Lore of Magic at the same time.

items.name: THE MYSTIC SHIELD OF BRAG
items.text: The Mystic Shield of Brag may be used against any enemy spell that directly targets any friendly unit within dispel range. The enemy spell has no effect.

items.name: BECALMING ORB
items.text: All enemy Wizards within 18" of the bearer of this item suffer a -2 casting penalty.

items.name: MYSTIC MAZE
items.text: The Mystic Maze may be used against any enemy spell that directly targets any friendly unit within dispel range. Roll 3D6 measured from the centre of the unit; this is the distance the spell scatters in a random direction. Should the spell end up on another unit, this unit will become the target of the spell; otherwise the spell has no effect.

items.name: TOME OF SPELLCRAFT
items.text: This item allows the bearer to re-roll one failed casting attempt each Magic phase.

items.name: HYPNOTIC EYE SCROLL
items.text: The Hypnotic Eye Scroll can be used whenever an enemy wizard successfully casts a spell instead of attempting to dispel. The casting wizard must pass a Leadership test; if failed, you may choose the target of the spell just as if you had cast the spell yourself. If no target can be chosen, the spell has no effect. Note that the spell is still cast from the original Wizard as normal.

items.name: SCROLL OF LYKOS
items.text: Bound Spell. This item contains the Arcane Urgency spell from the Lore of Battle Magic.

items.name: SCROLL OF DISRUPTION
items.text: This item allows the bearer to re- roll failed dispel attempts for the remainder of the Magic phase.

items.name: TRICKSTER'S SHARD
items.text: Declare you are using this item at the start of one of your magic phases. For the duration of the phase, when one of the bearer's spells is dispelled by an enemy Wizard, roll a D6. On a 4+, that Wizard suffers a Wound which Ignores Armour Saves.

items.name: JUSTINTINE'S PAYCHEST
items.only: Paymaster with Pay Chest or Pay Cart
items.text: The Paymaster and any unit they are with gain the Cold- blooded special rule.

items.name: LIFESTONE OF ASHRAAZ
items.text: The Lifestone of Ashraaz can be used at the start of any close combat phase. The bearer can swap his current number Wounds with the current number of Wounds of any one enemy model in base contact. The effect lasts the remainder of the game.

items.name: THE OTHER TRICKSTER'S SHARD
items.text: The bearer, and all units in base contact with them (friend and foe) must re-roll successful invulnerable saves.

items.name: ARCH-LIGHTNING ROD
items.text: This item may be used at the start of any enemy Movement phase. Once used, no units within 24" of the bearer may use the Fly special rule this turn.

items.name: RING OF LIFE
items.text: Choose a friendly model within 12" and roll a D6. On a roll of a 1 that model loses one Wound with no saves allowed, on a roll of a 2 nothing happens, on a roll of a 3-5 that model regains one Wound up to the models starting value, and on a roll of a 6 that model regains all lost wounds.

items.name: SINISTER CONTRACT
items.text: When the bearer and any unit they join fail the first Break test during the game, instead treat them as having the Unstable special rule until the end of the turn.

items.name: WYSSAN'S WEIGHTED DICE
items.text: This item may be used at the start of any close combat phase in which they are involved in. When used, choose two numbers from 1 to 6. For the remainder of this round, all dice rolls of the first number are treated as the second number. This applies to both you and your opponent's dice.

items.name: THE TERRIFYING MASK OF EEE!
items.text: The wearer of this mask causes Terror. However, other models can never use their Leadership.

items.name: EYE OF THE TILEAN MUR
items.text: The bearer has the Always Strikes First and Armour Piercing (1) special rules in any turn they successfully charge an enemy in the flank or rear.

items.name: THE LAST CHANCE
items.text: This item can be used in the shooting phase with the model's missile weapon. If the shot hits, it will automatically Wound with the Ignores Armour Saves special rule.

items.name: PAYMASTER'S COIN
items.text:
The model may re-roll one dice when rolling To Hit or To Wound each round of close combat.
MASTRO VIVETTI’S MAGNIFICENT

items.name: MACROSCOPE
items.text: No enemy units may deploy using the Scouts special rule within Line of Sight of the bearer of this item. In addition, you opponent must reveal any Hidden models in units within Line of Sight at the start of the game.

items.name: SCALED BOOTS OF DELAYED ALACRITY
items.text: The bearer gains the Random Movement (2D6) Special Rule.

items.name: BANNER OF MIGHT
items.text: A unit with this standard gains +1 To Hit in the first round of close combat.

items.name: BANNER OF SWIRLING WIND
items.text: All enemy missile fire targeting the unit carrying this standard suffer -1 To Hit.

items.name: BANNER OF MONTE CASTELLO
items.text: The unit carrying this standard gains the Cold-blooded special rule.

items.name: EAGLE BANNER
items.text: Enemies can never get the Outnumber, Flank or Rear combat resolution bonus against the unit carrying this standard.

items.name: ENSIGN OF THE REMAN LEGION
items.text: A unit carrying this magic standard has the Fight in Extra Ranks (1) special rule.

items.name: MONSTER HUNTER'S TAPESTRY
items.text: The unit carrying this standard gains the Immunity (Stomps) special rule.

items.name: PENNANT OF LOYALTY
items.text: The unit carrying this standard can re-roll the result on the Mercenaries table.

upgrades.name: GRIZZLED WARRIOR
upgrades.text: All successful To Wound rolls against this model must be re-rolled.

upgrades.name: CHARISMATIC LEADER
upgrades.text: The model gains the Inspiring Presence (6) special rule.

upgrades.name: GREEDY
upgrades.text: All friendly models using the Paymaster's Hold Your Ground ability may choose to re-roll just one of the dice when taking Break or Panic tests.

upgrades.name: EAGLE EYE
upgrades.text: The model gains the Sniper special rule.

upgrades.name: BEASTSLAYER
upgrades.text: The model gains the Multiple Wounds (2) special rule.

upgrades.name: BLOOD FEUD
upgrades.text: The model has the Hatred special rule.

upgrades.name: DEFIANT
upgrades.text: The model gains the Stubborn special rule.

upgrades.name: EXECUTIONER
upgrades.text: The model gains the Killing Blow special rule.

upgrades.name: FEARSOME REPUTATION
upgrades.text: The model gains the Fear special rule.

upgrades.name: RANGER
upgrades.text: The model gains the Scouts special rule.

upgrades.name: TACTICIAN
upgrades.text: One per army. You may add +1 to the result when determining who chooses which side of the table to deploy on.

upgrades.name: BERSERKER
upgrades.text: The model gains the Frenzy special rule.

upgrades.name: BLADEMASTER
upgrades.text: The model gains the Parry (6+) special rule.

upgrades.name: DIPLOMAT
upgrades.text: One unit of Dwarfs, Norse, Elves, Halflings, Ogres, Orcs or Hobgoblins may be taken as a Core Unit instead of a Special Unit, or as a Special Unit instead of a Rare Unit.

upgrades.name: HARD HITTER
upgrades.text: The model gains the Mighty Blow (1) special rule.

upgrades.name: POISONER
upgrades.text: The model gains the Poisoned Attacks special rule.

upgrades.name: BATTLE-EAGER
upgrades.text: The model gains the Vanguard special rule.

upgrades.name: DRILLED
upgrades.text: The model gains the Disciplined special rule.

upgrades.name: FEARLESS
upgrades.text: The model gains the Immunity (Fear, Panic) special rule.

upgrades.name: FLEET-FOOTED

spells.name: VOLATILE WIZARDRY
spells.text: Whenever a Wizard successfully casts a spell from this lore, they gain a +1 casting bonus for the remainder of the Magic phase. This bonus is cumulative. However, if they Miscast, they must add this casting bonus to the result rolled on the Miscast table.

spells.name: HAMMERHAND
spells.text: Hammerhand is a direct damage spell that causes 2D6 Strength 4 hits on one enemy unit in base contact with the caster.

spells.name: FLIGHT OF ZIMMERAN
spells.text: Flight of Zimmeran is a conveyance spell with a range of 18". One friendly Character may immediately make a move using the Fly (10) special rule as if it were the Remaining Moves sub-phase.

spells.name: MAGICAL MIGHT
spells.text: Magical Might is an augment spell with a range of 18". The target gains the Mighty Blow (1) special rule until the start of the caster's next Magic phase.

spells.name: CURSE OF COWARDLY FLIGHT
spells.text: Curse of Cowardly Flight is a hex spell with a range of 18". The target must immediately take a Panic test with a -1 Leadership modifier.

spells.name: DREAD OF ARAMAR
spells.text: Dread of Aramar is a hex aura spell with a range of 12". The target units treat all enemy units in base contact as causing Fear until the start of the caster's next Magic phase.

spells.name: ARCANE URGENCY
spells.text: Arcane Urgency is a conveyance spell with a range of 18". The target may immediately make a move as if it were the Remaining Moves sub-phase.

spells.name: DEATHLY SHARDS
spells.text: Deathly Shards is a magic missile with a range of 24" that causes D6 Strength 4 Hits with the Armour Piercing (1) special rule.

spells.name: HANDS OF KARKORA
spells.text: Hands of Karkora is a hex spell with a range of 24". Until the start of the caster's next Magic phase, all close combat attacks targeting the unit will always Hit on a 3+ or better, and all models in the unit can only Hit on a 4+ or worse themselves.

spells.name: SWORD OF REZHEBEL
spells.text: Remains in Play. Sword of Rezhebel is an augment spell with a range of 18" that can be cast on a friendly Character. While the spell is in effect, the model gains +1 To Hit, +2 Strength, +1 Attack as well as the Flaming Attacks and Magical Attacks special rules to their close combat attacks.

spells.name: ARROW STORM
spells.text: Arrow Storm is an augment spell with a range of 18". The target gains the Multiple Shot (2) special rule until the start of the caster's next Magic phase. Weapons that already fire Multiple Shots instead fire an additional shot. This has no effect on Magic Items or artillery weapons.

spells.name: CRIMSON BANDS
spells.text: Crimson Bands is a hex spell with a range of 24". All models in the target unit suffer a -1 penalty to their Attacks until the start of the caster's next Magic phase.

spells.name: GLEAMING ARROW
spells.text: Gleaming Arrow is a magical missile with a range of 24" that targets a single enemy model (even a character in a unit). The target suffers D3 Strength 4 Hits.

spells.name: MANACLE OF CALOE
spells.text: Manacle of Caloe is a hex spell with a range of 24". The target unit has all its movement halved until the start of the caster's next Magic phase.

specialRulesBody.name: Money Lender
specialRulesBody.text: The Money Lender must be placed in base contact with the Paymaster, but may not otherwise be targeted separately from the unit. They are only armed with a hand weapon. If a Paymaster is accompanied by a Money Lender, any unit using their Hold Your Ground special rule adds +1 to their Leadership.

specialRulesBody.name: Paymaster
specialRulesBody.text: You must include one (and only one) Paymaster in the army. The Paymaster follows all the rules for Battle Standard Bearers. A Paymaster with a Paychest or Paycart can have a magic banner with no points limit. If the Paymaster is slain, all friendly units suffer -1 to their Leadership for the remainder of the game and gain the Hatred special rule against the enemy unit or model that killed the Paymaster.

As long as the Paymaster is alive, the unit is Stubborn.

units.name: ORCS
units.specialRules:
• Animosity: Units with this special rule must test for Animosity in the Charge sub-phase after all normal charges have been declared during each of your turns, unless any of the following applies:
  - The unit has fewer than 5 models.
  - The unit has declared a charge this turn.
  - The unit is engaged in close combat.
  - The unit is garrisoning a building.
  - The unit is fleeing or currently off the battlefield.
Roll a D6 for each eligible unit. If the dice roll is a 2 or more, the unit behaves normally this turn. If the roll is a 1, however, the unit has failed its Animosity test and must roll on the Animosity table below:
D6 | Result
1 | Get 'Em: For every complete rank the unit has, it suffers D3 hits at the Strength characteristic of the majority of the models in the unit. The unit may not voluntarily move or shoot this turn. Wounds caused by the Get 'Em result never cause Panic tests.
2-4 | Squabble: If it is possible to do so, the unit must declare a charge against the closest viable enemy unit. If the unit is unable to declare a charge, the unit may not move in the Movement phase or shoot this turn.
5-6 | We'll Show 'Em: Pivot the unit on the spot to face the nearest visible enemy unit, and then make a full normal move in a straight line towards it. If there is no visible enemy, the unit must move straight ahead instead. If it is impossible for the unit to pivot to face the closest enemy, it will pivot towards it as far as it can, and will then move as far forward as it can while still keeping the enemy within its forward arc. After the move is complete the unit must declare a charge against the closest visible enemy unit, if it is possible to do so. If the unit cannot declare a charge then it may carry on with the rest of its turn normally, as if it had not yet moved this turn.

units.specialRulesBody:
• Treacherous Gits: Units with this special rule must test for Treachery in the Charge sub-phase after all normal charges have been declared during each of your turns, by every unit that is subject to Treachery, unless any of the following applies:
- The unit has less than 5 models. - The unit has declared a charge this turn. - The unit is engaged in close combat. - The unit is garrisoning a building. - The unit is fleeing or currently off the battlefield.
Roll a D6 for each eligible unit. If the dice roll is a 2 or more, the unit behaves normally this turn. If the roll is a 1, however, the unit has failed its Treachery test and must roll on the Treachery table below:
D6 | Result
1 | Traitor! If the unit is armed with missile weapons, they will immediately resolve a round of shooting against the nearest friendly unit within Line of Sight. If the unit does not have any missile weapons or if there are no friendly units within Line of Sight, they will inflict D3 Strength 3 Hits for every complete rank the unit has on themselves instead (any Wounds suffered will not cause a Panic test). The unit may not move, shoot or cast spells this turn.
2 | We'll get a better view from further back! The unit must immediately take a Panic test. If it's passed, the unit may not voluntarily move this turn.
3-4 | We Stayz 'Ere! The unit may not voluntarily move this turn.
5 | Bloody Murder! The unit suffers D3 Strength 3 Hits for every complete rank the unit has (any Wounds suffered will not cause a Panic test). The unit may move as normal afterwards.
6 | Cut 'em good! Pivot the unit on the spot to face the nearest visible enemy unit, and then make a full normal move in a straight line towards it. If there is no visible enemy, the unit must move straight ahead instead. If it is impossible for the unit to pivot to face the closest enemy, it will pivot towards it as far as it can, and will then move as far forward as it can while still keeping the enemy within its forward arc. After the move is complete the unit must declare a charge against the closest visible enemy unit, if it is possible to do so. If the unit cannot declare a charge it may carry on with the rest of its turn normally, as if it had not yet moved this turn.
